Definition: of uncertain affinity; a conjunction, preposition and adverb of continuance, until (of time and place):--even (until, unto), (as) far (as), how long, (un-)til(-l), (hither-, un-, up) to, while(-s).
BiblicalUsage: The word héōs is until, as long as — a small word, used 136 times; Matthew and Mark show it in use.
TheologicalSignificance: I take héōs as it stands — until, as long as — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
RelatedEvents: The Birth of Jesus; Jesus Sends Out the Twelve
